description:
Cursor-paginated list of a user's offer groups with nested offers. The `statuses` filter accepts one or more lifecycle states with OR semantics. The deprecated singular `status` parameter is a single-value alias; requests containing both are rejected. Omitting both defaults to `active` for backward compatibility.

**Maturity policy.** The list includes only offers whose maturity is at 15:00 UTC, the maturities Router quotes. Other offers are excluded before lifecycle, filters, type, callback, and group `expiry` are computed, and groups with no such offer are omitted. The by-group endpoint returns every offer regardless of maturity.

Lifecycle is derived from every latest 15:00 UTC offer revision before market, asset, maturity, type, callback, or listing filters are applied. `cancelled` has highest priority and requires an explicit `SetConsumed(type(uint128).max)` event; a `Take` reaching the same numeric value remains `filled`. Otherwise, a group is `filled` when every latest leg has no remaining capacity. It is `active` when at least one remaining leg has started and is at or before both its expiry and non-zero maturity. It is `scheduled` when no leg is active but at least one remaining leg starts in the future without having expired or matured. All remaining groups are `expired`. Active takes remain valid at exact expiry or maturity, matching the onchain inclusive boundary.

Nested offers are lifecycle-targeted for list results: active returns live remaining-capacity legs, scheduled returns future remaining-capacity legs, filled and cancelled return all latest legs, and expired returns terminal expired or matured legs. Active and scheduled group `expiry` is the maximum not-yet-ended latest-offer horizon; terminal statuses use the complete latest set. Requesting all five statuses returns every group with a 15:00 UTC offer exactly once.

**Callbacks.** A group has `callback.type=blue_buy` only when every latest offer considered for the lifecycle has the same callback address and data, contains canonical Blue market parameters with the matching loan token, and the earliest indexed registration from the official factory names the maker as owner at or before the offer's creation block. Registration transaction or log order within the same block is intentionally ignored. The callback is `null` when any condition fails. Verified callbacks include their address, decoded Blue market parameters, and derived Blue market id.

**Types.** Group `type` is derived from the shared `buy` and `reduce_only` values across all offers considered for the requested lifecycle. `buy` and `sell` mean `reduce_only=false`; `buy_reduce_only` and `sell_reduce_only` mean `reduce_only=true`. For the portfolio, `buy` and `sell_reduce_only` represent lend orders and secondary exits, while `sell` and `buy_reduce_only` represent borrow orders and secondary exits. Inconsistent groups return `type: null` and do not match the `types` filter. This describes offer intent, not the maker's current position.

**Filters.** `market_ids` filters the group page to groups containing at least one offer in the requested lifecycle and any requested market, but does not narrow nested sibling offers. `chain_ids` and `groups` filter the group page and nested offers. `loan_assets`, `collateral_assets`, exact `maturities`, and the inclusive unix-second bounds `maturity_gte` and `maturity_lte` filter both the group page and returned offers in the requested lifecycle for every status, and combine with other filters using AND semantics. `types` accepts comma-separated offer-group types with OR semantics and combines with other filters using AND semantics without narrowing nested offers. `callback_type=blue_buy` keeps only groups with verified Blue callback metadata. `listed=true` requires every lifecycle-matching offer in a group to be on a listed market; `listed=false` requires at least one lifecycle-matching unlisted offer. Address filters match across all chains unless `chain_ids` also narrows the query; lowercase addresses are checksummed. Group `expiry` is not narrowed by offer filters; active results use the active-eligible latest offer set, while expired results use the complete latest offer set. `created_at_gte` and `created_at_lte` filter by the first matching offer created in each group. `market_ids`, `loan_assets`, `collateral_assets`, `maturities`, `groups`, and `types` are capped at 20 values. Each offer includes both `market_id` and the immutable `market` config used to derive it, because uncreated markets cannot be decoded from `market_id` alone.

**Ratifier data.** Each nested offer includes the exact per-offer `ratifier_data` bytes originally submitted, plus `parsed_ratifier_data`, a structured view discriminated by `ratifier_type`. The type is identified by matching `ratifier` against the chain's known Midnight ratifier deployments: `rate_v1` exposes `rate_per_second_wad` and `allowed_taker`, `price_v1` exposes `allowed_taker` (the offer-level `tick` is the ratified price), and `ecrecover` and `setter` expose only their type. A zero `allowed_taker` means any taker may take the offer. An unrecognized ratifier address returns `unknown`; a recognized address whose `ratifier_data` cannot be decoded returns `invalid` with `expected_ratifier_type`.

**Pagination.** Response follows the list envelope: `{ cursor, data }`. Pagination is over groups; nested offers are not split across pages. Sort groups with `sort_by=id|created_at` and `sort_direction=asc|desc`.

callback_type.description: Filter by verified group callback type. blue_buy requires canonical Blue market params and an official factory registration owned by the maker at or before offer creation.

chain_ids.description: Filter by chain ids. Supported chains: Ethereum (1), Base (8453), Arc (5042), and Robinhood Chain (4663).

collateral_assets.description: Filter nested offers in the requested lifecycle by configured collateral token addresses. Combined with market_ids, loan_assets, maturities, and groups using AND semantics; lowercase input is checksummed.

created_at_gte.description: Filter for group created_at greater than or equal to this unix timestamp.

created_at_lte.description: Filter for group created_at less than or equal to this unix timestamp.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page response.

groups.description: Filter by offer group ids. Combined with market_ids, loan_assets, collateral_assets, and maturities using AND semantics.

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return.

listed.description: Filter by market listing status. When true, returns only groups where every offer in the requested lifecycle is on a listed market; when false, groups with at least one lifecycle-matching offer on an unlisted market. Omit to return both.

loan_assets.description: Filter nested offers in the requested lifecycle by loan token addresses. Combined with market_ids, collateral_assets, maturities, and groups using AND semantics.

market_family_ids.description: Filter groups to those containing offers in the requested lifecycle and Midnight market families. Combined with market_ids using AND semantics. Nested offers are not narrowed by this filter.

market_ids.description: Filter groups to those containing offers in the requested lifecycle and Midnight markets. Nested offers are not narrowed by this filter.

maturities.description: Filter nested offers in the requested lifecycle by exact market maturity timestamps, in unix seconds. Combined with market_ids, loan_assets, collateral_assets, and groups using AND semantics.

maturity_gte.description: Filter nested offers in the requested lifecycle by market maturity greater than or equal to this unix timestamp. Combined with market_ids, loan_assets, collateral_assets, maturities, and groups using AND semantics.

maturity_lte.description: Filter nested offers in the requested lifecycle by market maturity less than or equal to this unix timestamp. Combined with market_ids, loan_assets, collateral_assets, maturities, and groups using AND semantics.

sort_by.description: Sort field for group cursor pagination.

sort_direction.description: Sort direction for group cursor pagination.

status.description: Deprecated single-value alias for statuses. Omit both status and statuses to return active groups.

statuses.description: Filter by one or more offer-group lifecycle states using OR semantics. Combined with other filters using AND semantics. Omit both status and statuses to return active groups.

types.description: Filter by group offer intent. Multiple values use OR semantics. buy and sell mean reduce_only=false; buy_reduce_only and sell_reduce_only mean reduce_only=true. Combined with other filters using AND semantics.

user-address.description: User address whose offer groups should be listed.

name: morpho_midnight_list_user_offer_groups

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there is none.

callback.description: Verified group callback metadata, or null when the latest offer set is empty-callback, malformed, inconsistent, unregistered, registered to another owner, or registered after offer creation.

chain_id.description: Chain id where the group exists.

consumed.description: Latest consumed amount for this group.

created_at.description: Timestamp of the first matching status-targeted offer created in this group.

expiry.description: Maximum offer expiry derived from the group's latest offer set. Active and scheduled groups use the not-yet-ended horizon; terminal statuses use the complete latest set.

max_assets.description: Representative matching offer max assets for this group.

max_units.description: Representative matching offer max units for this group.

offers.description: Status-targeted latest offers matching the non-market request filters. Group-id lookup returns every latest offer revision regardless of status.

buy.description: Whether the offer is a buy offer.

continuous_fee_cap.description: Maximum continuous fee accepted by the maker.

market.description: Immutable market configuration used to derive market_id. This is included because market_id is a one-way hash and uncreated markets cannot be decoded from it.

collaterals.description: Collateral configuration used to derive the market id.

liquidation_cursor.description: Liquidation cursor for this collateral, WAD-scaled.

lltv.description: Liquidation loan-to-value for this collateral, WAD-scaled.

oracle.description: Oracle address used for this collateral.

maturity.description: Market maturity timestamp in unix seconds.

parsed_ratifier_data.description: Structured metadata decoded from ratifier_data. The ratifier type is identified by matching ratifier against the chain's known Midnight ratifier deployments; ratifier_data remains the authoritative raw bytes.

ratifier_data.description: Opaque per-offer ratifier data passed unchanged to Midnight take.

receiver_if_maker_is_seller.description: Receiver when the maker is the seller.

status.description: Current lifecycle status derived from every latest offer in the group.

type.description: Shared offer intent across the group's status-targeted offers, or null when their buy and reduce-only values are inconsistent.

ParsedRatifierDataInvalid.description: Ratifier address is a known deployment, but ratifier_data could not be decoded for its type.

expected_ratifier_type.description: Ratifier type identified from the ratifier address.

ParsedRatifierDataInvalid.title: Invalid

ParsedRatifierDataPriceV1.description: PriceRatifierV1 offer. The offer-level tick is the ratified price.

allowed_taker.description: Only taker allowed to take the offer. The zero address means any taker may take it.

ParsedRatifierDataPriceV1.title: PriceV1

allowed_taker.description: Only taker allowed to take the offer. The zero address means any taker may take it.

rate_per_second_wad.description: Per-second simple interest rate encoded in ratifier_data, WAD-scaled (1e18 = 100% per second).

ParsedRatifierDataUnknown.description: Ratifier address is not a known Midnight ratifier deployment.
ParsedRatifierDataUnknown.title: Unknown
